children: Shares of Syrma SGS Technology Limited closed 7.05 per cent higher at ₹1,617.70 on the NSE on Thursday, September 17, 2026, making it one of the top gainers in the electronics manufacturing services (EMS) space. The stock touched an intraday high of ₹1,658, with traded volume of 91.82 lakh shares and a traded value of ₹1,494.08 crore.

The rally was driven by Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s inauguration of SEMICON India 2026, held from September 17–19 at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi. The event, aimed at accelerating industry growth and positioning India as a global semiconductor hub, lifted shares of EMS companies across the board, with Syrma emerging as the top gainer.

title: Syrma SGS shares surge 7% as SEMICON India 2026 lifts EMS stocks
